_comment: Onomatopoeia lexicon (2026-08-02 customer feedback: 'the onomatopoeias everywhere are not good (ex: tap tap)'). These words are NOT banned as ordinary verbs ('Maya tapped on the door' is good writing) — the onomatopoeia check flags only sound-EFFECT usage: reduplication ('tap tap'), the known reduplicative pairs ('tick tock'), exclamation form ('Whoosh!'), and ALL-CAPS ('BOOM').
